clauses.evidence: Keyword ENCHANT params TYPE_EQ 'Creature'. Cast target slot 1..1 of [you_bear, you_giant, opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant]: creatures of both players only (no relic/charm/lands). Cost U-1 W-2 = {2}{U}.

clauses.clause: When this Aura enters, draw two cards, then discard a card.
clauses.evidence: Every [cast targets=...] variant: triggered ability [0], two DRAW events, then 'ask one_of' over the whole hand including both drawn cards, and the chosen card (you_spare / you_trick / you_land_drop / ... / you:Library 5#1 in the alternative variants) moves hand -> graveyard. Packs rousing_read_on_bear_flying and rousing_read_choice_and_leaves (controller discards Junk, not the lowest-handle Keeper; hand 3) PASS on the live tree and on this packet's tree.
clauses.issue: The discard selector is mode ONE_OF; the compiler template B2a-rousing-read emits CHOOSE, which in the hand-discard lane silently takes the lowest handle (see Kinetic Augur). ONE_OF is the faithful one here. Engine note: the probe's 'enters during the opponent's turn' stimulus puts the Aura onto the battlefield without a host; it draws two, discards, then dies as an unattached Aura, where CR 303.4f has the player choose what it enchants as it enters (harness path; reachable via Ugin's -10).

clauses.clause: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has flying.
clauses.evidence: Each cast: host +1/+1 and keywords +FLYING (you_bear 2/2 -> 3/3, you_giant 4/4 -> 5/5, opp_bear, opp_tapped, opp_giant likewise; opp_flier 1/1 -> 2/2, already flying), nothing wears off at end of turn. Pack rousing_read_choice_and_leaves: after Thrashing Brontodon destroys the Aura the Bear is 2/2 with no flying. Tree equal to parse template B5a-enchant-pt-flying.
